title: Local constant finite-module descriptions on an arbitrary site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], $B$ a commutative ring and $F$ a sheaf of $\underline B$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with constant coefficient modules as in [def-weil-pbc-constant-coefficient-scalar-extension]. Say that $F$ is locally constant of finite type if for every object $V$ there exists a covering sieve $S$ on $V$ such that for each $f:U\to V$ in $S$ there exists a finitely generated $B$-module $M$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and an isomorphism $F|_U\cong\underline M|_U$ of $\underline B|_U$-modules. Restriction is that of the localized ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. The module $M$ may depend on $f$; no points of the site are assumed.
